pr.title: Fix duplicate resource stopped events during restart
pr.author: JamesNK

failed_jobs.name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Hosting.Maui.Tests, Hosting.Maui, Hosting.Maui, tests/Aspire.Ho... / Hosting.Maui (windows-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: MauiBuildQueueTests.CancelQueuedResource_CompletesGracefullyAndDoesNotAcquireSemaphore asserts the exact exception type is OperationCanceledException but gets TaskCanceledException (a subclass). The PR only modifies DCP executor/orchestrator files, not Maui code, so this failure is unrelated to the PR changes.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Package tests - macOS (class, Aspire.Templates.Tests, Templates-XUnit_V3_NewUpAndBuildSupportProj... / Templates-XUnit_V3_NewUpAndBuildSupportProjectTemplatesTests (macos-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: CanNewAndBuild(aspire-xunit) fails with a Roslyn 'Method not found: EncodingExtensions.TryGetMaxCharCount' error compiling AssemblyAttributes.cs on macOS. This is a known class of macOS Roslyn/SDK binary-compatibility issue unrelated to the PR, which only touches DCP/Orchestrator source and tests.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: Test teardown fails with EBUSY resource busy/locked rmdir on a Windows temp workspace directory. This matches a well-established recurring flaky pattern (11+ prior occurrences) unrelated to the VS Code extension logic or the PR's DCP/Orchestrator changes.

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: Blazor browser debugger E2E test times out waiting for the Blazor page to become interactive. This matches a recurring known flaky pattern (27+ prior occurrences) unrelated to the PR's DCP/Orchestrator changes.
